claim: Pukas Surf Eskola operates from Avenida de la Zurriola 24 in San Sebastián, teaches surf since 1982 and offers individual, couple, three-person and group lesson formats year-round with booking via their online system.
quote: Pukas Surf Eskola San Sebastián. Avenida de la Zurriola 24. +34 943 320 068. With experience in surf classes since 1982.

claim: A 3-day course (4.5 hours total, 1.5h per session) at Pukas Surf Eskola on Zurriola Beach cost €161 per person including boards and summer wetsuits, working out to roughly €36 per 1.5-hour session.
quote: Cost: €161 per person for a 3-day course (1.5 hours per day = 4.5 hours total)... Surfboards and summer wetsuits provided.

claim: La Perla Thalassotherapy day tickets range €25–€54 with access to marine route, swimming pools, jacuzzis, saunas and aquatic gymnasium; weekday afternoon (13:30–16:00) discounted to €28 and a May–June Sunday Duo promo is €56 for two.
quote: Every Day Access: €25.00 – €54.00... Monday to Friday Afternoon Special (13:30–16:00): €28.00... Duo Promotion (May–June Sundays): €56.00

claim: La Perla is housed in the iconic centre on La Concha beach offering thalassotherapy circuits combining heated seawater pools, jets and saunas next to the bay.
quote: La Perla Thalassotherapy Centre • Spa, Beauty, Sport and Health

claim: Motoras de la Isla runs the Red Line to Santa Clara Island at €5 round trip (every 30 minutes, 10:00–20:00) and the Blue Line bay tour at €8; children under 4 free; high season is 1 June–30 September plus Easter and bank holidays.
quote: Red Line: Standard €5 per person... Blue Line (Bay Tour + Island): Standard €8... High Season: June 1 - September 30, plus Easter and Bank Holidays

claim: AloKayak rents from the harbour ramp next to the Aquarium (Paseo del Muelle 35): single kayak/SUP €14/hour, double €22/hour, family kayak (2 adults + 2 kids) €28/hour, all including paddle, life jacket and dry bag; Santa Clara Island is 800m away, about 20 minutes paddling.
quote: Single Kayak/SUP: €14/hour... Double Kayak/SUP: €22/hour... Family Kayak: €28/hour... 800 metres from our location... in about 20 minutes

claim: Sea water at San Sebastián averages 16°C in May (range 13.5–20.9°C), warming from ~16–17°C early in the month to ~18–19°C by late May — wetsuits still recommended.
quote: Average water temperature in San Sebastian in May is 16°C... Minimum: 13.5°C, Maximum: 20.9°C... temperatures rising from around 16-17°C in early May to approximately 18-19°C by late May.

claim: The official Zurriola swimming season runs June to September with water generally not dropping below 20°C, suitable for comfortable swimming.
quote: The swimming season in Zurriola Beach lasts from June to September, during which the water temperature does not drop below 20°C and is suitable for comfortable swimming.

claim: The Talaia route's Pasaia–Donostia segment is a shorter dramatic coastal section with vertical cliffs, the Lighthouse of La Plata, Mount Ulia caves and the 16th-century Monpás ruins, suited for hikers used to mixed-terrain paths.
quote: Pasaia-Donostia: A shorter segment from Pasaia to San Sebastian, characterized by dramatic coastal scenery with vertical cliffs and forest passages... Lighthouse of La Plata... Mount Ulia with distinctive cave formations... Historic ruins of Monpás with 16th-century origins

claim: The Monte Ulia loop from Gros (trailhead at Zemoria Kalea 47) covers 4.2 km, climbs to 234m at Peña del Rey and takes just over an hour, marked with green/white blazes; the GR-121 (red/white) extension reaches Pasaia.
quote: The official loop trail covers 2.6 miles (4.2 Km) with an excursion duration of slightly over one hour... The highest point reaches Peña del Rey at approximately 768 feet (234 meters)... The trailhead begins at Zemoria Street (Kalea) in the Gros neighborhood... house number 47

claim: La Concha bay is calm and shallow, sheltered by Mount Urgull, Mount Igeldo and Santa Clara Island, making it safe for swimmers of all levels with showers, toilets and lockers on site.
quote: La Concha is a very safe bay for swimming... Mount Urgull on one side and Mount Igeldo on the other protect the waters of La Concha... There's an island blocking the swell at La Concha so it is flat and safe.

claim: Santa Clara Island sits about 500m off shore in La Concha bay and has a small beach with bar, terrace, first-aid post and a natural seawater pool reachable by boat, kayak or open-water swim.
quote: Santa Clara Island is a small, picturesque island located in La Concha Bay, just 500 meters from the coastline of San Sebastian, accessible by boat, kayak, or swimming. The island beach offers all kinds of services, from a bar and terrace to a first aid post, and even its own natural swimming pool with sea water.
